content_sections.body: Prepare a two-turn exchange about preparing an A2.2 exchange. Give the main detail, listen to one follow-up, and answer it clearly. Use this model as support: 'I can make an arrangement, respond naturally, and change one detail if needed.' The exchange should meet this lesson goal: Prepare to use the A2.2 targets in a connected practical exchange.
content_sections.title: Use it in a practical exchange (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Partner A begins a realistic exchange about preparing an A2.2 exchange. Partner B asks for one missing detail. Swap roles and make one change to the time, place, reason, quantity, or next action. Check that the exchange achieves: Prepare to use the A2.2 targets in a connected practical exchange.
content_sections.title: Guided dialogue (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Create a short message about preparing an A2.2 exchange without reading the model. Include a main event or plan and one precise detail. Speak it once slowly, then once at a natural pace. Listen for whether the key information is clear.
